test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: It is a obvious that child needs love and attention of parents.
It is an obvious that child needs love and attention of parents.
It is obvious that a child needs love and attention of parents.
It is the obvious that child needs love and attention of parents.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. It is obvious that a child needs love and attention of parents. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence should use the article "a" before the noun "child" because it refers to any child in general, not a specific one.
 
• The phrase "an obvious" is incorrect because "obvious" is an adjective and needs a noun. The correct phrase is "it is obvious" to describe a general statement.
 
• The phrase "of parents" should be preceded by "the" to specify the love and attention of parents in general.

Correct sentence: *It is obvious that a child needs love and attention of the parents.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article Usage: **

 
 
• **"A/An": **Used before singular nouns that are not specified.
 
• **"The": **Used before specific or previously mentioned nouns.
 
 
 
• **Adjective Placement:**
 
 
• Adjectives typically precede the nouns they modify and do not require an article when used in statements like "it is obvious."
